E1003

Integer literal out of range for its width

What

Integer literal out of range for its width

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E1003

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1003: tests/ui/int_i64_out_of_range.stderr.

Error [E1003]: an I64 holds -9223372036854775808..9223372036854775807
  --> tests/ui/int_i64_out_of_range.jet:2:16
    |
  2 |     bad :: I64{9223372036854775808}
    |                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: an I64 is a fixed-width number — values outside its range can't fit
 Fix: use a number from -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807
